sites.name: shatterfall scree
sites.text: A slope of crushed glass in constant faint motion, loud underfoot.

sites.name: vitrified street
sites.text: A street preserved mid-morning: stalls, doorways, citizens of glass.

sites.name: glass orchard
sites.text: Rows of trees that were fruiting when the heat came. Some still are.

sites.name: annealing hall
sites.text: A vaulted workshop where the ovens have never fully cooled.

sites.name: watchman's rotunda
sites.text: A guard-round with sightlines in every direction, all of them yours to be seen from.

sites.name: the kiln galleries
sites.text: Chambers scoured smooth by the event itself. The walls have a flow direction.

sites.name: collapsed stockroom
sites.text: Shelving pancaked into strata of its own. Goods survive in the gaps.

sites.name: glazier's crypt
sites.text: Masters were interred with their best work. The work has kept better.

sites.name: a standing mirror
sites.text: Full-length, unbroken, facing away from the door.

sites.name: the murmur gallery
sites.text: A long room that repeats what it hears, not always promptly, not always accurately.

sites.name: a cold hearth-round
sites.text: Old fire-ring, stacked shard-benches. Delvers have rested here for generations.

sites.name: lantern niche
sites.text: A cut alcove with lamp-hooks and old wax. Defensible, quiet, almost kind.
